title: Totem Afterimage
description: A Fabric client timeline for visible totem-pop events, with self-pop emphasis and compact fight review.
body:
# Totem Afterimage

Totem Afterimage is a Fabric client timeline for visible totem-pop events. It gives PvP players a compact fight review HUD that shows recent pops, counts, and self-pop emphasis without exposing hidden information or taking any action for the player.

It is designed for crystal PvP, SMP fights, and practice servers where keeping track of recent totem pressure matters, but where automation would be unwanted.

## Features

- Records vanilla visible totem-pop status events
- Compact timeline of recent pops with entity labels and ages
- Self-pop highlight so dangerous moments are easy to notice
- Configurable retention time, row count, scale, position, and opacity
- Mod Menu config screen

## PvP Fairness

Totem Afterimage does not reveal private inventories, track unseen players, predict future pops, aim, click, move, or automate combat. It only listens to visible vanilla totem-use status packets that the client already receives.

## Compatibility

- Minecraft: 1.21.11
- Loader: Fabric
- Requires: Fabric API
- Optional: Mod Menu for in-game configuration
